with open("region.fasta") as f:
    lines = f.read().strip().split("\n")
seq = "".join(lines[1:]).upper()
comp = {"A":"T","T":"A","G":"C","C":"G"}
rev = "".join(comp[c] for c in reversed(seq))

codon_table = {
    "TTT":"F","TTC":"F","TTA":"L","TTG":"L","CTT":"L","CTC":"L","CTA":"L","CTG":"L",
    "ATT":"I","ATC":"I","ATA":"I","ATG":"M","GTT":"V","GTC":"V","GTA":"V","GTG":"V",
    "TCT":"S","TCC":"S","TCA":"S","TCG":"S","CCT":"P","CCC":"P","CCA":"P","CCG":"P",
    "ACT":"T","ACC":"T","ACA":"T","ACG":"T","GCT":"A","GCC":"A","GCA":"A","GCG":"A",
    "TAT":"Y","TAC":"Y","TAA":"*","TAG":"*","CAT":"H","CAC":"H","CAA":"Q","CAG":"Q",
    "AAT":"N","AAC":"N","AAA":"K","AAG":"K","GAT":"D","GAC":"D","GAA":"E","GAG":"E",
    "TGT":"C","TGC":"C","TGA":"*","TGA":"*","TGG":"W","CGT":"R","CGC":"R","CGA":"R","CGG":"R",
    "AGT":"S","AGC":"S","AGA":"R","AGG":"R","GGT":"G","GGC":"G","GGA":"G","GGG":"G"}

def find_orfs(sequence, min_aa=60):
    results = []
    L = len(sequence)
    for strand, s in [("+", sequence), ("-", rev)]:
        offset = 1 if strand == "-" else 0  # revcomp reads opposite; frame offsets same
        for frame in range(3):
            i = 0
            starts = []
            while frame + i*3 + 3 <= L:
                cod = s[frame + i*3: frame + i*3 + 3]
                aa = codon_table[cod]
                if aa == "M":
                    starts.append(i)
                elif aa == "*" and starts:
                    for st in starts:
                        ln = i - st
                        if ln >= min_aa:
                            ns, ne = frame + st*3, frame + i*3 + 3
                            if strand == "+":
                                gs, ge, gstart = ns, ne, ns
                            else:
                                gs, ge = L - ne, L - ns
                                gstart = ns  # local coords on revcomp
                            prot = "".join(codon_table[s[frame+st*3+x]] for x in range(0,(i-st)*3,3))
                            results.append((strand, frame, ln, gs, ge, prot))
                    starts = []
                i += 1
    return results

orfs = find_orfs(seq, 60)
print("ORFs >=60 aa (M->stop):")

    print("  protein:", prot)
    print()
